title: Generator-UPS Integration & Power Conditioning Pakistan 2026 — Harmonic Filtering, AFE Rectifier, AVR Stability, Generator Compatibility Requirements | Complete Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete guide to generator-UPS integration in Pakistan 2026. Covers generator sizing derating for non-linear UPS loads (6-pulse vs AFE rectifier), AVR compatibility (analogue vs DAVR vs PMG), harmonic distortion from UPS rectifiers and passive/active mitigation, AFE rectifier cost-benefit analysis, LESCO/IESCO/KESC grid-generator transfer protocols, 7 Pakistan-specific failure modes including synchronous reactance resonance, PMG demagnetisation, governor droop miscalibration, neutral overloading, fuel contamination, thermal derating and solar-generator-UPS interaction. PKR 2026 price table with 12 equipment categories. 10-point compatibility checklist and 7 common mistakes. IEC 62040-3, IEC 61000-3-2, IEC 61000-3-12, IEC 60034-1, NEPRA Grid Code 2023, NTDC PMM-P-2024, NFPA 110 compliance references.
